description: This file defines the AuthProviderChain class, which manages a sequence of authentication providers used in the authentication process within an HRM system. It allows adding providers with priorities, and authenticates using these providers in order of priority.

classes.name: AuthProviderChain
classes.description: Manages a chain of authentication providers, allowing addition with priorities and sequential authentication attempts.

methods.name: addProvider
methods.description: Adds an authentication provider to the chain, ensuring no duplicates and no priority conflicts.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate using the chain of providers based on their priority, returning true if any provider succeeds.
